verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a file-storage and collaboration platform, so a chunked or resumable upload API is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents upload sessions, chunking, or resuming after a dropped connection. The closest item describes streaming large files in blocks so they open quickly in desktop applications. That is a read/open capability, not reliable upload, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, big files upload reliably — documented chunked/resumable upload sessions that survive a dropped connection
